title: Blink vs Replit in 2026: Full-Stack Platform vs Developer Playground
summary: Blink is a full-stack AI app builder for non-technical founders. Replit is a coding environment for developers and learners. Both are genuinely good — for different people. Here's who should use which.
body_markdown: Blink for teams building apps. Replit for teams doing collaborative coding. Replit's credits-based model means costs scale with agent usage in ways that are hard to predict — multiple reviews document 3-4x overages on the Core plan. Active builders typically spend $50–$150/month despite the $20 subscription.[Blink](https://blink.new/) 's flat rate means the monthly cost is exactly the monthly cost, regardless of how many times you iterate with the AI.
